desktop.sys.camMic: Built into GifOS — it may use your camera and microphone. Apps you install cannot.
desktop.sys.appstore: Built into GifOS — it may put new apps on your Home Screen. Apps you install cannot.
desktop.hint.emptyFolder: Empty folder — drop files here or use ＋ Add.
desktop.hint.emptyHome: Drop any file here, or use ＋ Add. Double-click an app GIF to run it.
desktop.uphole.tip: Up to {name} — or drop things here to move them there
desktop.plate.note: The app’s own name, shown because this app is signed.
desktop.plate.file: The file is named “{file}” (Rename to change that).
desktop.badge.versionTip: Version {version} — the copy that arrived. Fresh: you haven’t saved anything in this app yet, and this tag goes away once you do.
desktop.badge.freshTip: Fresh — you haven’t saved anything in this app yet.
desktop.badge.lockTip: Passkey-locked — Open asks for your passkey. The icon still plays.
desktop.badge.providerTip: This is a Provider app — it can serve abilities (like AI models) to your whole computer, but ONLY from inside the Providers folder. Move it there to activate it; out here it does nothing.
desktop.badge.mirrorTip: Synced mirror — re-syncs to the original every time you open it.
desktop.sig.unverifiedTip: Signed by {id} — could not verify right now ({detail})
desktop.sig.pendingTip: Signed by {id} — tap Verify to check
desktop.sig.noneBody: This GIF is unsigned — it carries no provenance. Anyone can make an unsigned GIF, so treat it like a file from an unknown source.
desktop.sig.unchanged: The contents are unchanged since it was signed. This proves authorship — not that the app is safe.
desktop.sig.unchangedOn: The contents are unchanged since it was signed on {ts}. This proves authorship — not that the app is safe.
desktop.sig.keyChanged: ⚠️ The signing key is different from the first one you saw for this identity.
desktop.sig.unpinned: ⚠️ This is an older signature: {n, plural, one {# sealed file under .assets/ is} other {# sealed files under .assets/ are}} not covered by it. Ask the author for a re-signed copy.
desktop.sig.tamperedBody: ⚠️ Tampered. This GIF claims to be signed by {id}, but its contents were changed after signing. Do not trust it as coming from them.
desktop.sig.unverifiedHead: 🛡 Signed by {id}, but the signature couldn't be checked right now: {detail}.
desktop.sig.unverifiedDomain: The key must be published at https://{id}/gifos.key (with CORS).
desktop.sig.unverifiedEmail: Their key must be on keys.openpgp.org.
desktop.lock.builtIn: Built-in GifOS pages cannot be passkey-locked.
desktop.computer.title: This GIF is a whole computer
desktop.computer.body: "{name}" holds a whole GifOS computer. Boot it to run that computer in a new tab — your Home Screen here is untouched. Or replace this Home Screen with it (destructive).
desktop.backupFound.title: Desktop backup detected
desktop.backupFound.body: "{name}" is a full GifOS backup. Restore it? This replaces everything currently on this Home Screen.
desktop.dropHint: drop files anywhere to add them
desktop.trash.freed: This also frees the {size} of downloaded model data on this device.
desktop.trash.deleteBody: This deletes {name} forever. There is no undo.
desktop.trash.deleteBodyMore: This deletes {name} and {n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} inside it forever. There is no undo.
desktop.trash.emptyBody: Permanently delete {n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}? There is no undo.
desktop.rename.title: Rename
desktop.backup.failedBody:
The backup could not be built: {error}.

A very large computer can exceed what one GIF can hold in this browser; try again in a normal (not private) window with more free memory, or back up the biggest apps one at a time (right-click → Download).
desktop.restore.doneBody: Your Home Screen was restored from the backup GIF.
desktop.about.title: GifOS v{version}
desktop.about.body:
Your GIF-powered computer, right in your browser. Apps are GIFs. Data is GIFs.

Everything on this Home Screen lives in this browser — nothing on our servers.

What is GifOS? · Which browsers work · Source code · gifos.app

Something wrong? Report a problem on GitHub — the form opens with this build and browser filled in.
desktop.history.none: No invites visited yet. Open a friend’s invite link and it will show up here.
desktop.history.title: Invite history
desktop.history.intro: Sessions you’ve joined. Tap one to rejoin; the trash button removes it. This list lives only in this browser.
desktop.history.clearBody: Remove all {n, plural, one {# saved invite link} other {# saved invite links}}? This only clears the list on this device — the sessions themselves aren’t affected.
desktop.fetch.notLink: That doesn’t look like a web link.
desktop.fetch.tooBig: That file is bigger than {mb} MB — too large to open here.
desktop.fetch.network: Couldn’t load that link — the network refused, or the site it’s on won’t let another page read the file (no CORS). Use a direct link to the GIF bytes (for GitHub, the raw.githubusercontent.com link works), or save the GIF to your device and use ＋ Add file(s).
desktop.fetch.partway: The download failed partway — {detail}. A very large app needs a normal (not private) window and enough free memory.
desktop.fetch.notGif: That link isn’t a GIF file.
desktop.run.largeBody: This link downloads a {size} app from {host}. It is kept on this device so it opens offline next time. Continue?
desktop.run.cantSaveBody:
{detail}
Saving a very large app usually fails in a private/incognito window — open gifos.app in a normal window and tap the link again.
desktop.run.addedBody: {name} was added to your Stolen Apps. (It isn’t a runnable app GIF, so it wasn’t launched.)
desktop.retired.title: Build v{gone} has been retired
desktop.retired.body: This computer was pinned to v{gone}, which is no longer available, so it now runs {here}. Your files, apps and settings are untouched — every build reads the same desktop. You can pin a different build any time in Settings → Version.
desktop.place.nothingBody: That install didn’t finish — the app’s file isn’t on this computer. Try installing it again.
desktop.place.providerBody: It’s in your Providers folder — it can now serve your computer. Assign it to an AI type in Settings → AI models and every app that asks for that ability will use it.
desktop.place.homeBody: It’s on your Home Screen now — a GIF file you own. Copy it anywhere; it runs anywhere.
desktop.add.title: Add to your Home Screen
desktop.add.shareHelp: Share a one-tap link: gifos.app/?run=<gif link> — or a store name, gifos.app/?run=anyroad — opens that app and saves it to your Stolen Apps. Some apps can be opened on something: ?run=anyroad&go.at=Grand Canyon&go.fly=1. Whoever follows it sees what the link is asking for, and decides.
desktop.add.aiTitle: Ask an AI to build you an app
desktop.add.aiHelp: Copy this prompt into any AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini…). It asks what you want, then hands you back a finished .gif file — add it with ＋ Add file(s) above, or just drop it on your Home Screen.
desktop.add.builderHelp: If your AI could only reply with code, paste its complete index.html below and GifOS packs the GIF for you right here. (A .zip via ＋ Add file(s) works for multi-file apps.)
desktop.add.htmlPlaceholder: Paste the AI's complete index.html here (a ```html code block is fine)
desktop.add.signHelp: Made an app? Sign it 🛡️ so people see “Signed by you” — with your domain or email.
desktop.add.copied: Copied — now paste it into any AI
desktop.restoreFile.notBackupBody: That GIF is not a GifOS backup. (App snapshots load by dropping them on the Home Screen.)
desktop.restoreFile.title: Restore this backup?
desktop.restoreFile.body: This replaces everything currently on this Home Screen with the backup's contents.
desktop.reset.channel: You stay on the same version channel you are using now (edge, the live release, or a pinned snapshot).
desktop.reset.title: Erase this entire computer?
desktop.reset.body: This wipes every app, file, folder, and wallpaper stored in this browser. There is no undo and no server copy. {channel}
desktop.reset.doneBody: Your computer image is downloading — it can boot or restore this exact computer later. Erase now? {channel}
desktop.arrange.title: Arranging icons
